nude: The two small figures are nude. Tripo accepted the catalogue photograph of this piece on 8 Oct; Muse is untested. Try one clay view; if refused, use the fallback.

front.alt:
Marble sculpture depicting the thumb of a carved hand holding rock from which two emerging figures flow into each other,
rising from a base of unworked stone.

back.alt: Marble sculpture on a black backdrop featuring a detailed hand rising out of a large unworked stone base, fingers gripping a pillar of rock contrasting the smooth and rough textures.

side.alt: Marble sculpture showing a large hand rising from a roughly carved block, its fingers curved around a chunk of stone with hints of a human form emerging from it.

views.threequarter: no photograph: Muse turns it from the front

right.alt: Marble sculpture on a dark backdrop with a base of uncarved stone from which a hand rises holding a rock from which two intertwined figures emerge.
